# Best Slim Qi2 / MagSafe Power Banks for iPhone 17

The iPhone 17 supports **Qi2.2 at 25W** wireless charging, so it charges fastest with a 25W bank. The trade-off is that 25W banks are 10,000 mAh and thicker. The slimmest banks are 5,000 mAh and charge at 15W or less.

## Top picks

**Slimmest with fast 25W charging: INIU SnapGo Air (10K, Qi2.2)**
- 0.5 in thick, 195 g
- 25W wireless, 45W wired, with an LED display
- Includes a 60W braided USB-C cable that attaches like a lanyard
- About $43–$55
- Macworld calls it one of the "equal slimmest" 10K MagSafe packs. Android Central ranks it high for value.
- Buy: the links are in [Android Central's review](https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/i-tested-the-best-slim-qi2-power-banks-released-in-2026-baseus-torras-iniu-reelcharge) and [Macworld's guide](https://www.macworld.com/article/668978/feature-best-magsafe-magnetic-portable-battery-packs-power-banks-for-iphone.html).

**Thinnest true Qi2: Anker Nano Power Bank (5K, MagGo, Slim)**
- 0.34 in (8.6 mm) thick, 122 g
- 15W Qi2 wireless, 20W USB-C
- 9to5Mac says it runs cooler than competitors and is the closest alternative to Apple's own MagSafe battery
- About 60–75% of a full iPhone charge
- [Buy at Anker – $54.99](https://www.anker.com/products/a1665-5k-ultra-slim-qi2-power-bank)

## Worth considering

- **Ugreen MagFlow Pro (10K, Qi2.2):** 25W wireless, 45W wired, built-in USB-C cable. It had the best capacity test score in Macworld's testing and also ties for slimmest 10K. 9to5Mac lists it at about $59.99 on Amazon, in orange and blue colors that match the iPhone 17. [Macworld](https://www.macworld.com/article/668978/feature-best-magsafe-magnetic-portable-battery-packs-power-banks-for-iphone.html) / [9to5Mac](https://9to5mac.com/2026/06/27/favorite-magsafe-iphone-battery-banks-right-now/)
- **ReelCharge ReelSafe (5K):** 0.35 in, 119 g, 15W, semi-solid-state battery, LED display, $49.99. [Android Central](https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/i-tested-the-best-slim-qi2-power-banks-released-in-2026-baseus-torras-iniu-reelcharge)
- **Baseus PicoGo AM52 (10K, Qi2.2):** 25W wireless, 45W wired. It costs $59.99, or $53.99 with code **AM52**, which Dealectric confirmed worked in Baseus's checkout on 10/24. The listing doesn't give its thickness, so I can't confirm it's slim. [Buy via Dealectric](https://dealectric.com/go/baseus-picogo-am52-qi2-2-10000mah-45w) (this is an affiliate link)

## Skip if you want speed

- **Baseus PicoGo Air AM71:** At 0.27 in and 104 g it's the thinnest bank tested, but it charges at only **7.5W** wirelessly.
- **Apple MagSafe Battery:** It's $99, tuned for the iPhone Air, and charges at only 12W. Third-party banks are faster.

**Bottom line:** For an iPhone 17, I'd pick the **INIU SnapGo Air** for the best mix of slim size and 25W speed. If you'd rather have the thinnest possible bank and can live with 15W, get the **Anker Nano 5K Slim**.
